title: the_parkour_map_i_never_finished
display_title: I found my dead best friend's name in a Minecraft parkour map's save file
beats: I found my best friend's gamertag in a parkour map's leaderboard file, three months after he died.
We used to grind this exact map together every night, racing each other block by block.
I never told anyone I kept his old world files instead of deleting them like his mom asked.
Last week I loaded his save just to hear the death sound one more time, and his last checkpoint was one jump from the end.
I finished the jump for him and haven't told a single person until now.
Was I wrong to keep something she asked me to delete?
